title: Photography content
slide_intent: Teach editors to choose the story an image can tell. A visible detail, expression or action gives a reader a way into that story.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can communicate a range of experiences by selecting for energy, impact, individuality and human connection.
demonstration: The six images from the style page reappear with new subject captions and campaign headlines set in colored strips.
practical_value: Name the editorial purpose of a candidate image, then judge whether the headline and the photograph support that reading together.

content_islands.name: Subject brief
content_islands.spec: Place the content heading, short explanation and reference to illustration in the narrow column on the left.

content_islands.name: Captioned examples
content_islands.spec: Reuse the two-row grid. Place bright headline strips within each photo and set its content criterion and explanation below. Include both everyday details and challenging subjects.
